Only in Pip

Your child taps the words. Pip handles the grammar.

Kids who use AAC often tap the short version: "Mimi go park." One tap turns it into the sentence they meant, in the tense they meant, out loud.

Mimi go park
  • Fix it"Mimi goes to the park."
  • Question"Is Mimi going to the park?"
  • Past"Mimi went to the park."
  • Future"Mimi is going to the park."

Every tap speaks the new sentence out loud. The buttons never move.

Any sentence, with feeling.

Happy, sad, or angry, one tap on a face. A furious "go away" finally sounds furious.

trains ✨ trains

No picture? Pip draws one.

Type a new word and Pip draws its picture in the same friendly style as the rest of the board.

Where Pip is different.

$249.99 before the first word.

Proloquo2Go costs $249.99 up front. Every built-in word in Pip speaks free, tonight, on the iPad you already own. Lifetime for the whole team is $49.

Word by word, or the whole sentence.

Proloquo2Go has every tense, one word at a time, through a touch-and-hold popup. Pip changes the whole sentence to past, present, or future with one tap.

The whole team, on their own devices.

Proloquo2Go keeps devices in step by passing backup files around. In Pip, every helper edits from their own phone or laptop, free, and the iPad has it the same day.

Try Pip tonight alongside what you have.

It's free, so it costs you nothing to see the difference.
